target_customer: Mobile anime fans who watch short vertical series and creators who publish AI made series
problem: Fans want more anime stories than studios make. Mochi lets fans create AI produced vertical anime series and watch them in a mobile feed.
business_model: Consumer subscription and coin unlocks for episodes
product_category: Consumer AI entertainment, vertical anime shorts

founders.name: Robert Qiu
previous_startups: Game startup scaled to $200K monthly revenue (per the YC page)
Top 50 NFT project with $100M+ trade volume (per the YC page)
founders.background_notes: Ex FAANG, employer not named on the YC page.

founders.name: Michael Ninh
founders.role: Team member listed on the YC page, no title
founders.background_notes: Led consumer growth at Massdrop. Listed as team, not founder. Dealroom keywords name him alongside Qiu.

technical_complexity.rationale: Relies on third party video generation models plus a production pipeline for consistent characters and a mobile app with a creator tool. The hard part is quality and volume at low cost, not new research.

defensibility.rationale: Creator and viewer community and a catalog of originals could compound, but generation tools are available to everyone and franchise characters are blocked on major tools.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: General AI video platforms listed anime as a use case by late 2026. No acquisition reported.

market_need_then: Short vertical drama apps were growing and the company reports 300M+ social views and 20K+ creators within two months, but these are company claims.

branding.domain_note: Uses mochi.tv, a TV TLD domain rather than mochi.com.

identity.visual_style: Streaming style catalog with genre rows

branding.brand_signature: Anime for fans, made by fans with AI
branding.community_and_virality: Company reports 300M+ views on social platforms and 20K+ creators (unverified).

brand_strength.rationale: Cute memorable word tied to Japanese rice cake culture, but heavily confused with Genmo Mochi 1, Emochi and others, and no independent brand coverage was found.

outcome_analysis: Mochi is a Summer 2026 consumer startup with fast reported social growth and a creator community. No verified funding exists and traction figures are company claims. Copyright limits on franchise characters and the pace of general AI video tools are the main risks, and no outcome has occurred.
notes: Dealroom lists a $125K seed with investors behind a paywall; single aggregator source so not recorded as a round. Team size is 5 in the directory and 3 on the YC page. No competitor dated near the 2025 founding was found, so the list is empty. Footer credits GENERAL ANIME, Corp. as the operating entity. Do not confuse with Genmo Mochi 1 or Emochi. Update: the 125K seed is now recorded as a round with no date or investors, resting on a single database (Dealroom); a cross-check found no second source.
